commands.name: new
commands.plain: Start a project: a small program, a test and a manifest.
commands.dev: Creates guion.toml, README.md and src/main.gu; refuses a path that already exists.

commands.name: check
commands.plain: Read the code and say what is wrong, with the line and a stable code.
commands.dev: Compiles and reports the function count. --json gives a versioned report, or a diagnostic with a stable code and line/column.

commands.name: fmt
commands.plain: Tidy the spacing. Comments and text inside quotes are left alone.
commands.dev: Tokenizes outside comments and strings and normalizes spacing; --check reports unformatted files without writing.

commands.name: lint
commands.plain: Point out names nobody uses and code that can never run.
commands.dev: Compiles first, then warns with W_UNUSED_IMPORT, W_UNUSED_LOCAL and W_UNREACHABLE_STATEMENT.

commands.name: test
commands.plain: Run every test, each from a fresh start.
commands.dev: Runs each zero-argument Unit function named test_* in its own fresh runtime instance.

commands.name: run
commands.plain: Run a program, from source or from a built file.
commands.dev: Compiles and executes source, runs a .gub without source, or resolves the entry from a project directory. Grants come from flags and guion.toml.

commands.name: build
commands.plain: Turn the program into one portable file with a recorded fingerprint.
commands.dev: Writes a versioned bytecode artifact; metadata records compiler version, build host and the exact source graph digest.

commands.name: package
commands.plain: Pack the program and the runtime it needs into a folder you can hand over.
commands.dev: Creates a current-host, source-free application directory: compiled artifact, matching runtime, project policy, launcher and declared resources.

commands.name: verify-package
commands.plain: Check that a packed folder is what it says it is.
commands.dev: Checks the package target and the recorded SHA-256 digests of the artifact, runtime and resources.

commands.name: add
commands.args: NAME [--version RANGE] | NAME --path DIR | NAME --url HTTPS_URL --version V --sha256 H
commands.plain: Add a library from the Guion package registry, a local folder, or a web address you can check by hash.
commands.dev: Adds a registry library (after checking the index, the hash log and the bytes agree), a local native package, or a content-verified archive. A registry range is recorded so update can follow it.

commands.name: sync
commands.plain: Check that the dependencies match the lock.
commands.dev: In a core build, --locked --offline validates native packages against the lock.

commands.name: update
commands.plain: Refresh dependencies on purpose, never by surprise.
commands.dev: Explicitly resolves native package sources, moves registry libraries to the newest release their recorded range allows, and transactionally updates the lock; a capability widening needs --approve-capabilities.

commands.name: inspect
commands.plain: Show what a program is able to do, before it runs.
commands.dev: Prints artifact and function metadata plus statically reachable runtime effects.

commands.name: doc
commands.plain: Print what the program offers: its functions and records, and their types.
commands.dev: Prints signatures; --json emits guion_api_report with parameter names, checked types and reachable effects.

commands.name: doctor
commands.plain: Report what this machine and this build can do.
commands.dev: Reports the current host and enabled profile; a core build reports Python interoperability disabled.

commands.name: install
commands.plain: Install a packed app and make it launchable.
commands.dev: Verifies the package, installs into share/guion/apps/NAME/VERSION and creates its launcher.

commands.name: publish
commands.plain: Share a library on the Guion package registry.
commands.dev: Checks the library (including its declared capabilities), packs it and uploads it with the publisher token in GUION_REGISTRY_TOKEN; a published version never changes.

commands.name: yank
commands.plain: Stop new projects from picking a version of your library.
commands.dev: Marks a published version yanked so resolution skips it; existing locks keep working. --undo restores it.

commands.name: token
commands.plain: Replace or withdraw your registry publishing token.
commands.dev: rotate issues a new token for the publisher in GUION_REGISTRY_TOKEN, prints it once and revokes the old one; revoke withdraws the token outright.
